21300-cowboy-songs-and-other-frontier-ba.title: Cowboy Songs And Other Frontier Ballads
21300-cowboy-songs-and-other-frontier-ba.creator: Unknown
21300-cowboy-songs-and-other-frontier-ba.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. to the student of literature, but also to  the student of the general history of the west. There is something  very curious in the reproduction here on this new continent of  essentially the conditions of ballad-growth which obtained in  mediæval England; including, by the way, sympathy for the outlaw,  Jesse James taking the place of Robin Hood.

arxiv-2103-02347.title: Rigidity of Fibonacci Circle Maps with a Flat Piece and Different Critical Exponents
arxiv-2103-02347.creator: TANGUE NDAWA Bertuel
arxiv-2103-02347.description: Abstract Abstract We consider order preserving C^{3} circle maps with a flat piece, Fibonacci rotation number, critical exponents (\ell_{1},\ell_{2}) and negative shwarzian derivative. This paper treat the geometry characteristic of the non-wondering (cantor (fractal)) set from a map of our class. We prove that, for (\ell_{1},\ell_{2}) in (1,2)^{2} , the geometry of system is degenerate (double exponentially fast).

arxiv-2107-10249.title: Investigating External Interaction Modality and Design Between Automated Vehicles and Pedestrians at Crossings
arxiv-2107-10249.creator: Sue Bai, Dakota Drake Legge, Ashley Young, Shan Bao, Feng Zhou
arxiv-2107-10249.description: Abstract In this study, we investigated the effectiveness and user acceptance of three external interaction modalities (i.e., visual, auditory, and visual+auditory) in promoting communications between automated vehicle systems (AVS) and pedestrians at a crosswalk through a large number of combined designs. For this purpose, an online survey was designed and distributed to 68 participants.

arxiv-2305-16625.title: Set-based Neural Network Encoding Without Weight Tying
arxiv-2305-16625.creator: Bruno Andreis, Soro Bedionita, Philip H.S. Torr, Sung Ju Hwang, KAIST, South Korea, University of Oxford, United Kingdom, DeepAuto.ai, South Korea {andries, sorobedio, sjhwang82}@kaist.ac.kr, philip.torr@eng.ox.ac.uk
arxiv-2305-16625.description: Abstract We propose a neural network weight encoding method for network property prediction that utilizes set-to-set and set-to-vector functions to efficiently encode neural network parameters. Our approach is capable of encoding neural networks in a model zoo of mixed architecture and different parameter sizes as opposed to previous approaches that require custom encoding models for different architectures.

arxiv-2309-02314.title: The role of three-nucleon potentials within the shell model: past and present
arxiv-2309-02314.creator: L. Coraggio, G. De Gregorio, T. Fukui, A. Gargano, Y. Z. Ma, Z. H. Cheng, F. R. Xu
arxiv-2309-02314.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by L. Coraggio, G. De Gregorio, T. Fukui, A. Gargano, Y. Z. Ma, Z. H. Cheng, F. R. Xu. We survey the impact of nuclear three-body forces on structure properties of nuclei within the shell model. It has long been acknowledged, since the seminal works of Zuker and coworkers, that three-body forces play a fundamental role in making the monopole component of shell-model Hamiltonians, derived from realistic nucleon-nucleon potentials, able to reproduce the observed evolution of the shell structure.

arxiv-2403-02614.title: Generation of True Quantum Random Numbers with On-Demand Probability Distributions via Single-Photon Quantum Walks Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2403-02614.creator: Chaoying Meng, 1,3, † {\dagger} Miao Cai, 2,3, † {\dagger} Yufang Yang, 1,3 Haodong Wu, 2,3 Zhixiang Li, 2,3 Yaping Ruan, 2,3 Yong Zhang, 2 Han Zhang, 1,3,* Keyu Xia, 2,3,4* Franco Nori, 5,6
arxiv-2403-02614.description: Abstract Random numbers are at the heart of diverse fields, ranging from simulations of stochastic processes to classical and quantum cryptography. The requirement for true randomness in these applications has motivated various proposals for generating random numbers based on the inherent randomness of quantum systems.

arxiv-2409-17236.title: Measuring Entanglement by Exploiting its Anti-symmetric Nature
arxiv-2409-17236.creator: Peyman Azodi 1, Benjamin Lienhard 1,2, and Herschel A. Rabitz 1
arxiv-2409-17236.description: Abstract Despite significant progress in experimental quantum sciences, measuring entanglement entropy remains challenging. Through a geometric perspective, we reveal the intrinsic anti-symmetric nature of entanglement. We prove that most entanglement measures, such as von Neumann and Rényi entropies, can be expressed in terms of exterior products, which are fundamentally anti-symmetric.

arxiv-2411-00819.title: A Bellman-Ford algorithm for the path-length-weighted distance in graphs
arxiv-2411-00819.creator: R. Arnau, J. M. Calabuig, L. M. García Raffi, E. A. Sánchez Pérez, S. Sanjuan
arxiv-2411-00819.description: Abstract . Consider a finite directed graph without cycles in which the arrows are weighted. We present an algorithm for the computation of a new distance, called path-length-weighted distance, which has proven useful for graph analysis in the context of fraud detection.

arxiv-2503-08594.title: 3D Point Cloud Generation via Autoregressive Up-sampling
arxiv-2503-08594.creator: Ziqiao Meng, Qichao Wang, Zhipeng Zhou, Irwin King, Peilin Zhao
arxiv-2503-08594.description: Abstract We introduce a pioneering autoregressive generative model for 3D point cloud generation. Inspired by visual autoregressive modeling (VAR), we conceptualize point cloud generation as an autoregressive up-sampling process. This leads to our novel model, PointARU , which progressively refines 3D point clouds from coarse to fine scales.

arxiv-2509-06824.title: Modulation instability and frequency-comb generation in hybrid quadratic-cubic resonators with spectral filtering
arxiv-2509-06824.creator: Minji Shi, Nicolas Englebert, François Leo, Dmitry V. Skryabin, Auro M. Perego
arxiv-2509-06824.description: Abstract We present an analytical and numerical investigation into the phenomenon of filter-induced modulation instability in passive hybrid optical resonators exhibiting quadratic and cubic nonlinearity. We show that asymmetric spectral losses, with respect to the continuous-wave solution frequency, can trigger sideband amplification in the normal dispersion regime. We calculate the parametric gain and demonstrate the associated pattern formation process.

arxiv-2509-24550.title: Training-Free Multimodal Guidance for Video to Audio Generation
arxiv-2509-24550.description: Abstract Video-to-audio (V2A) generation aims to synthesize realistic and semantically aligned audio from silent videos, with potential applications in video editing, Foley sound design, and assistive multimedia. Although the excellent results, existing approaches either require costly joint training on large-scale paired datasets or rely on pairwise similarities that may fail to capture global multimodal coherence.

arxiv-2601-00454.title: Defensive M2S: Training Guardrail Models on Compressed Multi-turn Conversations
arxiv-2601-00454.creator: Hyunjun Kim
arxiv-2601-00454.description: Abstract Guardrail models are essential for ensuring the safety of Large Language Model (LLM) deployments, but processing full multi-turn conversation histories incurs significant computational cost. We propose Defensive M2S , a training paradigm that fine-tunes guardrail models on Multi-turn to Single-turn (M2S) compressed conversations rather than complete dialogue histories.

pmc-11340152.title: In vitro characterization of probiotic potential of Lactobacillus plantarum CM49 against selected cattle mastitogens
pmc-11340152.creator: Muhammad Zeeshan Izhar, Muhammad Nawaz, Tahir Yaqub, Muhammad Avais, Aftab Ahmad Anjum
pmc-11340152.description: BackgroundBovine mastitis results in significant economic losses for the dairy industry globally due to milk production losses and decreased herd efficiency. This research aimed to isolate, select, and characterize indigenous lactobacilli with probiotic properties. A total of 40 lactobacilli were isolated from healthy milk samples of cattle and identified at the species level through 16S rDNA sequencing.

pmc-11374201.title: Outcomes of medial to lateral vs. lateral to medial approaches in laparoscopic colorectal cancer resections
pmc-11374201.creator: Muhammad Rafaih Iqbal, Kaso Ari, Spencer Probert, Wenyi Cai, Wafaa Ramadan, Sarah-Jane Walton
pmc-11374201.description: Introduction:Bowel cancer is a significant global health concern, ranking as the third most prevalent cancer worldwide. Laparoscopic resections have become a standard treatment modality for resectable colorectal cancer. This study aimed to compare the clinical and oncological outcomes of medial to lateral (ML) vs lateral to medial (LM) approaches in laparoscopic colorectal cancer resections.

pmc-11430033.creator: Tonka Blažević, Mirna Natalija Aničić, Stanko Ćavar, Jurica Vuković, Quentin Ballouhey
pmc-11430033.description: Autoimmune pancreatitis type 2 is a relatively novel entity with some still controversial issues. The current diagnostic algorithm relies on imaging studies and histology. Therapy includes corticosteroids with consequently low risk of relapse in the following year. However, the pathogenesis remains unclear, and data are insufficient for long-term prognosis.

pmc-12663674.title: First case of Aureobasidium pullulans in a dog after sterilization surgery in Chile

pmc-12731195.creator: Minho Jeong, Beom Chang Kim, Hyoung Jin Choi, Gyu Tae Lee, Sang-Min Jang, Kee-Beom Kim
pmc-12731195.description: Objectives: Small cell lung cancer (SCLC) is an aggressive neuroendocrine carcinoma characterized by rapid proliferation, early metastasis, and limited therapeutic response. Metabolic reprogramming is increasingly recognized as a key feature of small cell lung cancer progression, yet the contribution of specific metabolic enzymes remains incompletely understood.

pmc-13341988.title: Characterization of individuals with skeletal dysplasia at a referral center in Brazil
pmc-13341988.creator: J. G. C. Meira, M. P. Migliavacca, A. X. Acosta
pmc-13341988.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In Brazil, limited data challenge diagnosis and management. pmc-13669790.creator: Fábio R. M. Leite, Gustavo G. Nascimento, Marco A. Peres
pmc-13669790.description: BackgroundPeriodontitis remains one of the most prevalent chronic diseases worldwide and is strongly socially patterned.
